---
title: "Best supportive care — unadjusted and adjusted model fitting"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(mice)
library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(posterior)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

# Return the fit if it meets every diagnostic threshold, otherwise refit it
# once with twice the iterations and a new seed.
refit_if_unconverged <- function(model, seed) {
  thresholds <- config$diagnostics
  parameters <- summarise_draws(as_draws_array(model))
  sampler <- rstan::get_sampler_params(model$stanfit, inc_warmup = FALSE)

  bfmi <- map_dbl(
    sampler,
    \(chain) mean(diff(chain[, "energy__"])^2) / var(chain[, "energy__"])
  )
  divergences <- sum(map_dbl(sampler, \(chain) sum(chain[, "divergent__"])))
  treedepth_hits <- sum(map_dbl(sampler, \(chain) sum(chain[, "treedepth__"] >= 10)))

  passed <- max(parameters$rhat, na.rm = TRUE) <= thresholds$max_rhat &&
    min(parameters$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE) >= thresholds$min_ess_bulk &&
    min(parameters$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE) >= thresholds$min_ess_tail &&
    divergences <= thresholds$max_divergent_transitions &&
    treedepth_hits <= thresholds$max_treedepth_exceeded &&
    min(bfmi) >= thresholds$min_bfmi

  if (passed) {
    return(model)
  }

  retry_seed <- seed + 500000L
  update(model, iter = 4000L, warmup = 2000L, seed = retry_seed)
}

results_dir <- here("analysis", "06-best-supportive-care", "results")
imputation_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations")
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

m <- config$imputation$m_supporting

event_columns <- c(cause_specific = "event_bsc", composite = "event_bsc_or_death")

prepared <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
fixed_imputation <- readRDS(file.path(imputation_dir, "fixed.rds"))

stopifnot(fixed_imputation$m == m, nrow(prepared) > 0L)
```

## Unadjusted and Adjusted (fixed)

```{r}
#| label: fit-unadjusted-and-fixed
#| include: false
unadjusted_seed_offset <- c(cause_specific = 1600, composite = 1601)
fixed_seed_offset <- c(cause_specific = 1800, composite = 1900)

for (endpoint_name in names(event_columns)) {
  unadjusted_data <- prepared |>
    transmute(
      id,
      tx,
      time_to_bsc_days,
      event = .data[[event_columns[[endpoint_name]]]]
    )

  stopifnot(sum(unadjusted_data$event) > 0L)

  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0("unadjusted-", endpoint_name, ".rds"))

  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    seed <- config$seeds$supporting + unadjusted_seed_offset[[endpoint_name]]

    model <- stan_surv(
      formula = Surv(time_to_bsc_days, event) ~ tx,
      data = unadjusted_data,
      basehaz = "ms",
      basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      prior = normal(0, 0.55),
      prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
      prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
      chains = 4L,
      cores = 4L,
      iter = 2000L,
      warmup = 1000L,
      refresh = 0L,
      seed = seed
    )
    model <- refit_if_unconverged(model, seed)
    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }

  for (index in seq_len(m)) {
    completed <- complete(fixed_imputation, index)

    stopifnot(
      all(as.integer(as.character(completed$ecog_binary)) ==
            derive_ecog_binary(completed$ecog_fstcnt)),
      all(as.integer(as.character(completed$mgps)) ==
            derive_mgps(completed$albumin, completed$c_reactive_protein))
    )

    fitting_data <- completed |>
      transmute(
        id,
        tx,
        time_to_bsc_days,
        event = .data[[event_columns[[endpoint_name]]]],
        ecog_binary,
        stage_binary,
        lung,
        mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2)
      )

    stopifnot(!anyNA(fitting_data), all(fitting_data$time_to_bsc_days > 0))

    model_path <- file.path(
      model_dir,
      sprintf("fixed-%s-%02d.rds", endpoint_name, index)
    )
    if (file.exists(model_path)) next

    seed <- config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 +
      fixed_seed_offset[[endpoint_name]]

    model <- stan_surv(
      formula = Surv(time_to_bsc_days, event) ~
        tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
      data = fitting_data,
      basehaz = "ms",
      basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      prior = normal(location = rep(0, 6), scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 5))),
      prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
      prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
      chains = 4L,
      cores = 4L,
      iter = 2000L,
      warmup = 1000L,
      refresh = 0L,
      seed = seed
    )
    model <- refit_if_unconverged(model, seed)
    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
}
```

## Adjusted (hierarchical)

```{r}
#| label: fit-hierarchical
#| include: false
hierarchical_seed_offset <- c(cause_specific = 2800L, composite = 2900L)

hierarchical_completed <- readRDS(file.path(imputation_dir, "hierarchical-completed.rds"))
stopifnot(length(hierarchical_completed) == m)

for (index in seq_len(m)) {
  completed <- hierarchical_completed[[index]]

  stopifnot(
    all(as.integer(as.character(completed$ecog_binary)) ==
          derive_ecog_binary(completed$ecog_fstcnt)),
    all(as.integer(as.character(completed$mgps)) ==
          derive_mgps(completed$albumin, completed$c_reactive_protein))
  )

  for (endpoint_name in names(event_columns)) {
    fitting_data <- completed |>
      mutate(event = .data[[event_columns[[endpoint_name]]]])

    stopifnot(!anyNA(fitting_data), all(fitting_data$time_to_bsc_days > 0))

    model_path <- file.path(
      model_dir,
      sprintf("hierarchical-%s-%02d.rds", endpoint_name, index)
    )
    if (file.exists(model_path)) next

    seed <- index + hierarchical_seed_offset[[endpoint_name]]

    model <- stan_surv(
      formula = Surv(time_to_bsc_days, event) ~
        tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + mgps + (1 || diagnosis),
      data = fitting_data,
      basehaz = "ms",
      basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      prior = normal(location = rep(0, 5), scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 4))),
      prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
      prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
      prior_covariance = decov(),
      chains = 4L,
      cores = 4L,
      iter = 2000L,
      warmup = 1000L,
      adapt_delta = 0.99,
      refresh = 0L,
      seed = seed
    )
    model <- refit_if_unconverged(model, seed)
    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
}
```
